A Roman copper-alloy Radiate of Victorinus (AD 269-71) Reverse type INVICTVS, Cologne mint? AD 269-70. RIC113. Obverse description: right facing radiate and bearded bust. Obverse inscription: []ORINVS PF []. Reverse description: Sol advancing with right arm raised, whip over left shoulder and star in left field. Reverse inscription: [INV]I[CT]VS
